question: Two lines AB and CD intersect at O. If angle AOC = 50°, what is the measure of angle BOD (its vertically opposite angle)?
question_hi: Two lines AB and CD intersect at O. If angle AOC = 50°, what is the measure of angle BOD (its vertically opposite angle)?
question_gu: Two lines AB and CD intersect at O. If angle AOC = 50°, what is the measure of angle BOD (its vertically opposite angle)?
explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal. Since angle AOC and angle BOD are vertically opposite, angle BOD = 50°.
explanation_hi: Vertically opposite angles are equal. Since angle AOC and angle BOD are vertically opposite, angle BOD = 50°.
